description: PREFERRED: Update todo fields without iCal formatting. Supports: SUMMARY (title), DESCRIPTION (details), STATUS (NEEDS-ACTION/IN-PROCESS/COMPLETED/CANCELLED), PRIORITY (0-9), DUE (due date), PERCENT-COMPLETE (0-100), and any RFC 5545 VTODO property including custom X-* properties.

fields.description: Fields to update, keyed by bare UPPERCASE property name (e.g., SUMMARY, STATUS, PRIORITY). Any RFC 5545 VTODO property or custom X-* property is supported. Property parameters such as "DUE;VALUE=DATE" are not accepted here, and values must not contain line breaks.

STATUS.description: Todo status: NEEDS-ACTION, IN-PROCESS, COMPLETED, or CANCELLED

todo_etag.description: The etag of the todo (required for conflict detection)

todo_url.description: The URL of the todo to update

name: update_todo
